"Hot showers. Not the big things — the small, stupid, perfect things. Addis Ababa, Ethiopia in the morning, coffee going, nobody trying to kill me. I miss being bored."
"Wait — what were we talking about?"
"Still on what you miss most."
"Wait — what were we talking about?"
"As I said — Still on what you miss most."
"Yeah?"
"When's the last time you really laughed?"
"Recently — someone tripped over nothing and we all lost it. It felt like stealing."
"Stealing joy. I like that. We should steal more of it. It'll pass."
"Yeah?"
"Three days ago. Someone dropped a whole basket of tubers and we just stood there laughing. It wasn't even funny. It was the standing there."
"Yeah?"
"Alright. Catch you later."
They glance at the fire, then back. The quiet doesn't seem to bother them.
"Good talk. I feel like I know you a little better now."
"About the food I needed — I still haven't found anyone. Any chance?"
"Tell me why you need this."
"It's been days since a real meal. I can't pull my weight like this. Anything you can spare, I'll make it stretch."
Why can’t I do this now?
As I said — Move next to them, on the same side of the Haven door, to help.

Still the same thing — Move next to them, on the same side of the Haven door, to help.
Why can’t I do this now?
I've told you three times now — Move next to them, on the same side of the Haven door, to help.
Why can’t I do this now?
I've told you three times now — Move next to them, on the same side of the Haven door, to help.
"Go on."
"Okay I really have to move now or I'll explode — talk soon!"
"You're a good listener, you know that?" A tired smile.
"...Think about it? I'll be around."
